tasks.title: Build and smoke-test a native menu-bar app bundle

local_evidence.swift: Swift app host compiled for arm64-apple-macosx13.0.
local_evidence.smoke: tools/test_macos_app.sh passed for the native host architecture: app bundle/plist/executable checks, bundled loopback server startup, desktop and micro GETs, and refusal to produce an unsigned DMG.
local_evidence.universal: Universal arm64+x86_64 builder and CI smoke passed on the native macOS runner. The runner installed the Intel Rust standard library, checked both Rust and Swift executable slices, and fetched desktop and micro routes from the bundled service.
local_evidence.limitation: Local AppKit launch remains unavailable in the restricted LaunchServices environment (SIGABRT). Hosted CI verifies software paths; logged-in user session, accessibility, signing/notarization, Gatekeeper, and hardware acceptance remain separate.
local_evidence.appkit_ci: Exact head 7d77c9da0a72b55ff6c5a7fcb4ad5e384702e4e1 passed all 7 jobs in https://github.com/pskeffington/pip_boy/actions/runs/41786181479. Native macOS CI passed actual desktop/micro/Stop/Quit menu actions, live-child shutdown, Retry after missing service, and universal arm64+x86_64 app bundle smoke.

tasks.ci_evidence: Final Mac implementation head 708cf7aeb0eff3c6a657c33402d26fe640f739e8 passed 7/7 jobs in https://github.com/pskeffington/pip_boy/actions/runs/41787914386, including AppKit desktop/micro/Stop/Quit, live-child shutdown, Retry, and universal bundle smoke. This also validates the package-source regression that binds the release SHA to a clean git archive build.
software_acceptance: macOS native workflow builds and verifies arm64+x86_64 Rust and Swift slices
Universal bundle starts and serves desktop and micro loopback routes on the runner
Hosted macOS CI invokes the actual open, Stop, and Quit menu actions and verifies child exit
Hosted macOS CI verifies Quit asynchronously waits for its live child to exit
Hosted macOS CI verifies a missing bundled service exposes a working Retry action
Bundle includes an ICNS icon accepted by macOS iconutil plus tested version, copyright and category metadata; failed rebuilds preserve the existing app
release_acceptance: Interactive status-menu selection and browser behavior verified in a logged-in user session
Keyboard, VoiceOver, contrast and reduced-motion accessibility review completed

tasks.evidence: Source-bound packaging passed exact-head 7/7 CI at 708cf7aeb0eff3c6a657c33402d26fe640f739e8 in https://github.com/pskeffington/pip_boy/actions/runs/41787914386. Corrected head 51a26c33a2661f2535830bed25d4fd96fe338fee passed 7/7 CI in https://github.com/pskeffington/pip_boy/actions/runs/41791223195, including native macOS universal app smoke and package regression checks. Failure handling records private atomic failed-state evidence with source SHA and exit code while preserving existing context; head 350609d653a04c450d574b1780f1ad99cb5b0635 passed all seven jobs, including native macOS universal bundle smoke, in https://github.com/pskeffington/pip_boy/actions/runs/41793673976. A regression-coverage follow-up now executes the actual EXIT cleanup handler, verifies the original exit code is preserved, and confirms temporary directories are removed; local Mac smoke passes and exact-head CI is pending. The packager builds from a fresh git archive of the exact clean source SHA and ignores prebuilt app/binary overrides. No Apple signing identity or notarization profile is configured, so no signed artifact, notarization, or Gatekeeper result exists. Provisioning and evidence requirements are tracked in https://github.com/pskeffington/pip_boy/issues/94.
